M44Ig8m4BfU.title: Fainders.AI VCO in the Field | Toujours Cheonan and Niseko Resort, Japan
M44Ig8m4BfU.description:
Fainders.AI's AI unmanned checkout solution, VCO.
Active across bakeries, resorts, and more, delivering a new retail experience.

⑴99.7% checkout accuracy
Flawless vision AI with zero margin for error: accurately recognizes even complex, overlapping bread and products in one second, cutting off loss at the source.

⑵75% reduction in customer wait time
Ultra-fast checkout that prevents walkaways: no need to find and scan barcodes — just place the whole tray down and checkout is done.

⑶15% increase in sales
Maximizes turnover during peak hours: eliminates checkout bottlenecks during the busiest times, fully capturing additional sales that were previously being missed.

XZ3gEzfrWN0.title: Why VCO Is Different ③: Look-Alike From Above, Not to VCO
XZ3gEzfrWN0.description:
What actually sets VCO (Vision Check Out) from Fainders.AI apart?
Can it really tell apart items that look identical from above?

[Other solutions]
Top-view recognition only, so items that look the same from above are hard to tell apart.

[Fainders.AI VCO]
14 cameras read the sides as well as the top, so even items that look identical from above are identified correctly.

_0FCk3XMS5w.title: Why VCO Is Different ②: It Tells Look-Alike Pastries Apart
_0FCk3XMS5w.description:
What actually sets VCO (Vision Check Out) from Fainders.AI apart?

[Other solutions]
Plain salt pastry, basil salt pastry, hard salt pastry. They look alike but have different names and prices, and systems that can't tell them apart cause checkout errors.

[Fainders.AI VCO]
99% accuracy on look-alike items. VCO correctly identifies breads that look the same but aren't.

1E0bPZMJZ-o.title: Why VCO Is Different ①: Customers Fix Overlap Errors Themselves
1E0bPZMJZ-o.description:
What actually sets VCO (Vision Check Out) from Fainders.AI apart?

[Other solutions]
When overlapping items cause an error, a staff member has to step in and fix it.

[Fainders.AI VCO]
When overlapping items cause an error, the customer just rearranges them and it clears.
